notes: Landscape, straight-on, three bays of a Japanese bookshop's 軍事・戦争 (military and war) section in Naha, Okinawa, under even shop light with no glare; a camera timestamp '2025.01.17 20:45' is burned into the lower right. Japanese throughout, with a few romanised words (SENKAKU, FBI, AI, CIA). Five shelves per bay: the top two hold face-out covers, which are all labelled; the third shelf holds spines that read at full resolution and its left and middle bays are labelled; the third shelf's right bay and the fourth and fifth shelves hold roughly two hundred further spines that also read at full resolution but were NOT labelled for want of time, so this label is incomplete on the lower shelves and a model's extra titles from those rows should not be treated as invented without checking. Titles as printed: 観光と「性」 keeps its brackets; 第一次世界大戦 is labelled by its large title and drops the tagline 軍事史としての; 世界の軍事情勢 drops the lead-in 地図でスッと頭に入る; 尖閣1945 (cover SENKAKU / 尖閣 / 1945, also on a spine) is labelled once; シギント, 安全保障のリアル, 知られざる海上保安庁 and この国の危機管理 失敗の本質 drop their small subtitles; 公安外事警察の正体 corrects the draft's '正の外事'. Partial: 情報分析力 (小泉悠), a white cover on the second shelf half hidden behind 国防の禁句 so only three of its large characters show. Removed from the draft: 軍事史としての20世紀 (a tagline), 公安事件警察, 工作, 外事警察秘録, マキャロカ (not found), その他全国紙 (a newspaper-rack sign). Left out as unlabelled: the white cover at the top left reading 非戦論 with its first characters hidden, スパイゲーム and the small spines beside 防諜論 on the second shelf, the 戦争の教訓 and 戦略的思考 spines on the third shelf whose full titles are uncertain, and the lower shelves described above. Readable faces: politicians on the 13歳から考える戦争入門 cover (Putin among them), Xi Jinping and Abe on the 国防の禁句 cover, a soldier's portrait on 第一次世界大戦.
